name: Infisical
description: Infisical is the open source secret management platform that developers use to centralize their application configuration and secrets like API keys and database credentials.
composeYaml:
services:
  backend:
    image: 'infisical/infisical:v0.154.6'
    environment:
      - 'SITE_URL=${APP_URL}'
      - 'NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-production}'
      - 'ENCRYPTION_KEY=${ENCRYPTIONKEY}'
      - 'AUTH_SECRET=${AUTHSECRET}'
      - 'SMTP_HOST=${SMTP_HOST}'
      - 'SMTP_USERNAME=${SMTP_USERNAME}'
      - 'SMTP_PASSWORD=${SMTP_PASSWORD}'
      - 'SMTP_PORT=${SMTP_PORT}'
      - 'SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS=${SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS}'
      - 'SMTP_FROM_NAME=${SMTP_FROM_NAME}'
      - 'INF_APP_CONNECTION_GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID=${INF_APP_CONNECTION_GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_ID}'
      - 'INF_APP_CONNECTION_GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_SECRET=${INF_APP_CONNECTION_GITHUB_APP_CLIENT_SECRET}'
      - 'INF_APP_CONNECTION_GITHUB_APP_SLUG=${INF_APP_CONNECTION_GITHUB_APP_SLUG}'
      - 'INF_APP_CONNECTION_GITHUB_APP_ID=${INF_APP_CONNECTION_GITHUB_APP_ID}'
      - 'INF_APP_CONNECTION_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY=${INF_APP_CONNECTION_GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY}'
      - 'DB_CONNECTION_URI=postgres://${POSTGRES_USER}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB}'
      - 'REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/status || exit 1'
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
  redis:
    image: 'redis:7'
    volumes:
      - 'redis-data:/data'
    environment:
      - 'ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD=${ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD:-yes}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'redis-cli -h localhost -p 6379 ping'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
  db:
    image: 'postgres:14-alpine'
    volumes:
      - 'pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}'
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}'
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-infisical}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -h localhost -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
